title: Gradient Boosting Machine Learning Pipeline Intro

cues.en: In the previous section and a group of lectures, we implemented a rule based AI system for our transaction analysis and fraud detection.
cues.zh: 上一章的這幾堂課，我們為交易分析與詐欺偵測實作了規則式 AI 系統。

cues.en: The rule based AI system that we implemented has its disadvantages, such as one limited adaptability, meaning we cannot automatically adjust to new fraud patterns without manual intervention.
cues.zh: 這個系統有一些缺點，第一是適應能力有限，也就是無法在沒有人工介入的情況下，自動因應新的詐欺模式。

cues.en: Then lack of personalization.
cues.zh: 第二是缺乏個人化。

cues.en: As we realized in our implementation, we applied the same rules to all our customers, thus ignoring the individual behavior patterns or differences.
cues.zh: 在實作中，我們對所有客戶套用同樣的規則，忽略個人的行為模式或差異。

cues.en: Then the third disadvantages the maintenance burden.
cues.zh: 第三個缺點是維護負擔。

cues.en: Our rule based AI system requires constant manual rule updates as fraudsters evolve their tactics.
cues.zh: 詐騙者的手法不斷演進，規則式 AI 系統需要持續手動更新規則。

cues.en: Then it also has some scalability issues as new fraud scenarios emerge.
cues.zh: 當新的詐欺情境出現時，也會有擴充性的問題。

cues.en: Rule complexity grows exponentially, making the system harder to manage.
cues.zh: 規則複雜度呈指數成長，讓系統更難管理。

cues.en: Then we have handling complex relationships.
cues.zh: 接著是處理複雜關係的能力。

cues.en: As we realized our rule based implementation was reduced to simple if then logic, and thus this will struggle with interactions between multiple variables.
cues.zh: 我們的規則式實作歸結為簡單的 if-then 邏輯，因此很難處理多個變數之間的交互作用。

cues.en: Then lastly, limited context awareness.
cues.zh: 最後是對情境的掌握有限。

cues.en: Our rule based implementation struggles to incorporate user history and behavioral patterns that machine learning models naturally leverage.
cues.zh: 規則式實作很難納入使用者紀錄與行為模式，而機器學習模型能自然運用這些資訊。

cues.en: And it's because of these disadvantages that moving forward we're going to overcome our limitations by enhancing our fraud detection system by integrating machine learning, specifically the gradient
cues.zh: 由於這些缺點，接下來會整合機器學習來強化詐欺偵測系統，克服現有的限制，具體採用梯度，

cues.en: boosting model.
cues.zh: 提升模型。

cues.en: Gradient boosting is highly effective for fraud detection in financial transactions for the following reasons.
cues.zh: 梯度提升很適合偵測金融交易中的詐欺，原因如下。

cues.en: One.
cues.zh: 第一，

cues.en: It's effective on imbalanced data, meaning it performs well even when a fraud accounts for less than 1% of the transactions.
cues.zh: 它能有效處理不平衡資料，即使詐欺交易不到所有交易的 1%，仍能有良好表現。

cues.en: Then two feature importance metrics.
cues.zh: 第二是特徵重要性指標。

cues.en: The gradient boosting model highlights which transaction attributes are most predictive of fraud, then three.
cues.zh: 梯度提升模型可以指出哪些交易屬性最能預測詐欺；第三，

cues.en: Recognition of non-linear patterns.
cues.zh: 是辨識非線性模式。

cues.en: By using an ensemble of decision trees, the gradient boosting model captures complex interactions between different variables.
cues.zh: 透過整合多棵決策樹，梯度提升模型能捕捉不同變數間複雜的交互作用。

cues.en: Then the gradient boosting model is optimized for structured data such as transaction records, which can have data such as amounts, timestamps, account IDs just like we do.
cues.zh: 它也很適合結構化資料，例如像我們這樣，包含金額、時間戳記、帳戶 ID 的交易紀錄。

cues.en: Then the gradient boosting model is very robust against outliers because of fraudulent transactions,
cues.zh: 另外，梯度提升模型對離群值具有很強的穩健性，因為詐欺交易，

cues.en: often appear as statistical anomalies, and gradient boosting handles these effectively.
cues.zh: 經常呈現為統計異常，而梯度提升能有效處理。

cues.en: By adopting gradient boosting, we aim to significantly enhance our fraud detection capabilities with a more adaptive and scalable and context aware approach.
cues.zh: 採用梯度提升，是希望用更具適應性、擴充性及情境感知能力的方法，大幅提升詐欺偵測效果。

cues.en: With that being said, that's the end of this lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: In the next lecture, we shall start working on our machine learning schema.
cues.zh: 下一堂開始處理機器學習的 schema。
